thread:
Maria C.: quick smoke test across regions/gpus for quant kernels — h100 vs a100 vs g5. testing FP16/BF16/INT8/FP8. posting raw notes + commands. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Aj Patel: nice. which model and seq len?
Maria C.: Llama-2-13B, seq=2048, batch=8 and batch=1 for p99. dataset = 500 eval prompts (mix of code + convo).
Kai L.: did you use our custom fused-attn kernel or triton default?
Maria C.: ran both. config summary: fused-attn=v2 on h100, triton on a100, cudnn fallback on g5.
perf-bot: automated run summary: h100 (eu-west): FP16 throughput 520 toks/s, p50 latency 42ms, p99 210ms. INT8 (nvq) throughput 900 toks/s (+73%), p99 340ms. quality delta vs fp16 (exact match): INT8 -0.9%, FP8 -1.2%, BF16 -0.1%.
Aj Patel: wow INT8 speedup on h100 is legit but p99 worsened. did you enable kv-cache reduction?
Maria C.: yes, kv-prefetch=on. INT8 runs used per-token requantization (our nvq profile).
Kai L.: what about a100/us-west?
perf-bot: a100 (us-west): FP16 throughput 340 toks/s, p50 62ms, p99 320ms. INT8 not stable on triton -> saw random output divergence at 0.6% EM. FP8 on a100 using gemm-int8 kernel gave throughput 620 toks/s, quality delta -1.1%.
Aj Patel: interesting that a100 FP8 is faster than FP16. kernel selection matters.
Maria C.: g5 (us-east) was slower overall: FP16 280 toks/s, INT8 420 toks/s. cudnn fallback limited batch packing.
Kai L.: any notable regression examples?
Maria C.: captured top-3 diffs. small hallucination on INT8 for a code generation prompt: changed variable name. EM dropped 2.4% on that subset.
Aj Patel: can you paste the run command?
Maria C.: sure:
```
./run_bench.sh --model llama2-13b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --quant INT8 --kernel fused-v2 --region eu-west --hw h100
```
Aj Patel: thanks. did you run with sharding/batch fusion?
Maria C.: no sharding. single-device. batch fusion enabled for throughput runs, disabled for p99 measurements.
perf-bot: script outputs (snippet):
```
Throughput: 520 toks/s
p50: 42 ms
p95: 130 ms
p99: 210 ms
Quality: EM delta -0.9% vs FP16
```
Kai L.: next steps: 1) re-run INT8 with our relaxed requant scale (alpha=1.05) to see p99 impact; 2) run a100 with fused kernel build (experimental); 3) add 1k eval prompts for stability.
Maria C.: agree. scheduling re-runs tomorrow. tagging @ops-bot to reserve capacity in eu-west h100 (2 cards for 3h).
ops-bot: reservation created: eu-west h100 x2 for 3h starting 2026-03-21T09:00Z.
Aj Patel: also add a short eval comparing perplexity and BLEU for the code subset to quantify deltas.
Kai L.: will do. I'll open a small PR to add the alpha sweep to the bench harness. :memo:
Maria C.: thanks all — keeping this thread for the smoke notes. I'll post updated CSVs + minimal plots once re-runs are done. :rocket:
